highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes the m150 engine with Ganesh and SkSL correctness fixes.
highlights_body: The update addresses stale GPU readbacks, failed resolve and flush handling, framebuffer cleanup, and RasterPipeline code generation.

bullets.lead: Ganesh failure handling is more reliable
bullets.detail: Failed flushes no longer return stale texture readbacks, and failed resolve tasks restore MSAA and mipmap dirty tracking.

bullets.lead: GPU and shader engine fixes are included
bullets.detail: Updates framebuffer deletion behavior for Imagination GPUs and fixes a use-after-free in SkSL RasterPipeline code generation.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2 alongside the SkiaSharp 4.150.2 servicing release.
